note: Stanislaus NF (Groveland RD) campground beside Highway 120 about 15 miles east of Groveland, near Yosemite's Big Oak Flat entrance, on an open, sparsely treed hillside; Rainbow Pools on the South Fork Tuolumne is 0.8 mile away. Run by the concessionaire American Land & Leisure. Walk-up payment is cash or check only. --Claude
summary: rec.gov description/notices/rates/catalog/calendar + FS page read. $29, 13 sites, 32 ft, no electric, vault toilets + seasonal water confirmed; added 6 people, 14 nights, 4-day cutoff, season Apr 26 - Oct 11 (calendar). FS page also says '$37.00 per night' - conflict flagged.
